notes: OCPA stores zoning as JURISDICTION-DISTRICT/overlays, e.g. ORL-R-3B/T/AN. Matching uses the base district after the jurisdiction prefix and before overlay suffixes. Edit this file to change what the multifamily toggle treats as allowed.
